dct_description_sm: Rising sea level induced by climate change and storm surge flooding are major concerns for coastal communities in New Brunswick. Previous studies in the Shediac Bay area indicate that the North Eastern and Eastern coast of New Brunswick are particularly vulnerable to these predicted changes. The purpose of this project was to collect data and  model the anticipated impacts and provide the Mi'gmaq of New Brunswick a tool to begin developing adaptation strategies for their communities.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Community vulnerability
dct_title_s: Assessment of Potential Impacts of Sea-level Rise and Climate Change on the Mi'Gmaq of New Brunswick
